# Cutscene

> Sequenced cutscenes: camera tweens, dialog, fades.

- Package: `Cutscene` · Category: Client systems
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Dialog](Dialog.md), [Promise](Promise.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Cutscene")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Cutscene")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Cutscene`

- Runs: **client only (LocalScript / client ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Client/CutsceneSystem.lua`

Get it:

```lua

local Cutscene = Gaxia.Cutscene
```
